module = "progenitors"
dataname = "initial"
library(here); i_am(file.path("analysis",module, "marker_gene_ontologies.Rmd"))
## here() starts at /projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/sc_rnaseq/upr_in_adipo
## here() starts at /projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/sc_rnaseq/upr_in_adipo
indir = here("data/cellranger/count_no_introns/day0")
odir = here("output", module, dataname) 
dataname = "initial"

if (!dir.exists(odir)){dir.create(odir, recursive = T)}

Default load=T and subset=F because its just marker genes.

library(clusterProfiler, quietly = T)
library(enrichplot)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
pal = c("#DA1819", "#00AED1", "#434D51","#EBB400","#691A93","#3AAD00")

Load marker lists

cluster_markers = read.delim(here(odir, "marker_genes.txt"))
cluster_markers = filter(cluster_markers, p_val_adj < 0.01)
all.genes = read.delim(here("data", "all.genes.txt"))[,1]
head(all.genes); length(all.genes)
## [1] "MIR1302-2HG" "FAM138A"     "OR4F5"       "AL627309.1"  "AL627309.3" 
## [6] "AL627309.2"
## [1] 36601
donor_markers = read.delim(here(odir, "donor_marker_genes.txt"))
donor_markers = filter(donor_markers, p_val_adj < 0.01)

GO setup

molsig <- clusterProfiler::read.gmt("/projects/imb-pkbphil/sp/annotations/molsigdb/msigdb.v2023.1.Hs.symbols.gmt")
head(molsig); nrow(molsig)
##      term       gene
## 1 chr1p11  LINC02798
## 2 chr1p11    MTIF2P1
## 3 chr1p11    SRGAP2C
## 4 chr1p11 SRGAP2-AS1
## 5 chr1p11  LINC01691
## 6 chr1p11     NBPF26
## [1] 3961711
##Pick gene sets to look in bcos all is a lot
prefixes = c("HALLMARK", "KEGG","REACTOME", "WP", "GOBP", "GOCC","GOMF")
colnames(molsig) = c("term","gene")
some.molsig = molsig[gsub("_.*","", molsig$term) %in% prefixes,]
some.molsig$term = factor(some.molsig$term)
table(gsub("_.*","", some.molsig$term))
## 
##     GOBP     GOCC     GOMF HALLMARK     KEGG REACTOME       WP 
##   642656    98915   108833     7322    12796    92769    31635
shorten = function(ont) {
  abbreviate(gsub("_"," ", tolower(ont)),minlength=40, dot=T, named = F)
}

Cluster GO

clgo = compareCluster(gene~cluster, data=filter(cluster_markers,p_val_adj < 0.01), 
                      fun="enricher", TERM2GENE = some.molsig, universe = all.genes)
head(clgo)[,c(2,4:9)]
##   cluster                                   Description GeneRatio   BgRatio
## 1       0                          GOCC_LYSOSOMAL_LUMEN    25/457  97/17901
## 2       0                          HALLMARK_COAGULATION    28/457 138/17901
## 3       0                           GOCC_VACUOLAR_LUMEN    29/457 175/17901
## 4       0 GOCC_COLLAGEN_CONTAINING_EXTRACELLULAR_MATRIX    42/457 415/17901
## 5       0                                 KEGG_LYSOSOME    21/457 120/17901
## 6       0                           HALLMARK_COMPLEMENT    26/457 200/17901
##         pvalue     p.adjust       qvalue
## 1 1.454779e-18 8.520638e-15 7.044191e-15
## 2 1.182717e-17 3.463587e-14 2.863420e-14
## 3 9.254015e-16 1.806692e-12 1.493631e-12
## 4 2.527062e-14 3.700251e-11 3.059075e-11
## 5 3.052893e-12 3.576159e-09 2.956486e-09
## 6 9.582707e-12 9.248072e-09 7.645576e-09
dotplot(clgo, x="cluster", showCategory=2) 

dotplot(clgo, x="cluster", showCategory=2, includeAll=F) 

dfgo = as.data.frame(clgo)
dfgo$short_desc =shorten(dfgo$Description)
go_to_plot = filter(dfgo) %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
              slice_min(n = 2, order_by = p.adjust)
go_to_plot$short_desc = factor(go_to_plot$short_desc, levels=rev(unique(go_to_plot$short_desc)))

p = ggplot(go_to_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count)) + 
  geom_point()+  theme_bw(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) 
p

include_all_plot = filter(dfgo, Description %in% go_to_plot$Description & p.adjust < 0.01)
include_all_plot$short_desc = factor(include_all_plot$short_desc, levels=levels(go_to_plot$short_desc))
a = ggplot(include_all_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count, alpha=Count)) + 
  geom_point()+  theme_bw(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) 
a

Remove hallmark terms

dfgo = as.data.frame(clgo)
dfgo$short_desc =shorten(dfgo$Description)
go_to_plot = filter(dfgo, !grepl("HALLMARK", Description)) %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
              slice_min(n = 2, order_by = p.adjust)
go_to_plot$short_desc = factor(go_to_plot$short_desc, levels=rev(unique(go_to_plot$short_desc)))

p = ggplot(go_to_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count)) + 
  geom_point()+  theme_bw(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) 
p

include_all_plot = filter(dfgo, Description %in% go_to_plot$Description & p.adjust < 0.01)
include_all_plot$short_desc = factor(include_all_plot$short_desc, levels=levels(go_to_plot$short_desc))
a = ggplot(include_all_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count)) + 
  geom_point()+  theme_bw(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) 
a

GO on donor specific genes

donorgo = compareCluster(gene~cluster, data=filter(donor_markers,p_val_adj < 0.01),
                         fun="enricher", TERM2GENE = some.molsig, universe = all.genes)
head(donorgo)[,c(2,4:9)]
##   cluster                       Description GeneRatio   BgRatio       pvalue
## 1      S1               GOCC_VACUOLAR_LUMEN   48/1155 175/17901 3.016098e-18
## 2      S1              GOCC_LYSOSOMAL_LUMEN   35/1155  97/17901 8.051581e-18
## 3      S1                     KEGG_LYSOSOME   36/1155 120/17901 2.321075e-15
## 4      S1 GOBP_FATTY_ACID_METABOLIC_PROCESS   66/1155 380/17901 1.212816e-13
## 5      S1              HALLMARK_COAGULATION   36/1155 138/17901 2.668436e-13
## 6      S1  HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB   43/1155 199/17901 1.506539e-12
##       p.adjust       qvalue
## 1 2.343508e-14 1.976020e-14
## 2 3.128039e-14 2.637529e-14
## 3 6.011586e-12 5.068903e-12
## 4 2.355896e-10 1.986465e-10
## 5 4.146749e-10 3.496494e-10
## 6 1.950968e-09 1.645035e-09
p = dotplot(donorgo, showCategory=4, x="cluster") 
p + scale_y_discrete(labels=shorten(levels(p$data$Description)))
## Scale for y is already present.
## Adding another scale for y, which will replace the existing scale.

p = dotplot(donorgo, showCategory=4, x="cluster", includeAll=F) 
p + scale_y_discrete(labels=shorten(levels(p$data$Description)))
## Scale for y is already present.
## Adding another scale for y, which will replace the existing scale.

dfgo = as.data.frame(donorgo)
dfgo$short_desc =shorten(dfgo$Description)
go_to_plot = filter(dfgo) %>% group_by(cluster) %>%
              slice_min(n = 4, order_by = p.adjust)
go_to_plot$short_desc = factor(go_to_plot$short_desc, levels=unique(rev(go_to_plot$short_desc)))

p = ggplot(go_to_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count)) + 
  geom_point()+  theme_bw(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) + scale_color_manual(values=pal)
p

include_all_plot = filter(dfgo, Description %in% go_to_plot$Description & p.adjust < 0.01)
include_all_plot$short_desc = factor(include_all_plot$short_desc, levels=levels(go_to_plot$short_desc))
a = ggplot(include_all_plot, aes(x=cluster, y=short_desc, colour=cluster, size=Count, alpha=Count)) + 
  geom_point()+  theme_bw(base_size=15) + 
  theme(axis.text.x=element_text(angle=30, hjust=1)) + scale_color_manual(values=pal)
a

nrow(clgo)
## [1] 3631

Save

  write.table(clgo, here(odir, "ORA_marker_genes.txt"),
            sep="\t", row.names = F)
  write.table(donorgo, here(odir, "ORA_donor_marker_genes.txt"),
            sep="\t", row.names = F)
